references.breusch_godfrey: statsmodels.stats.diagnostic.acorr_breusch_godfrey(OLS fit, nlags) — zero-padded lagged residuals, default nlags=min(10, T//5), a constant added to the auxiliary design when the model has none
references.durbin_watson_exact_pvalue: documented Imhof (1961) formula on the eigenvalues of Z'AZ (numpy complete QR + LAPACK eigvalsh), scipy.integrate.quad; two quadrature routes agree to 1e-12
